name: Nils Amiet
biography: Nils Amiet is a Security Engineer at Kudelski Security, where he performs big data analytics, leveraging Spark, Hadoop and Chapel clusters to analyze large datasets. He designed a data pipeline to snapshot the whole IPv4 address space for selected network protocols, allowing automated and reproducible offline data analysis. He also built an automated country security ranking. Nils likes open source software, data analytics, distributed systems and data processing.
